name: imap-mail
description: Agent-operated IMAP/SMTP email: read, draft, edit and explicitly send with account-bound verification.

interface.shortDescription: Read mail, create/edit drafts or explicitly send
interface.longDescription: Email tools for AI agents: search and read mail, compose or edit drafts, and send explicitly requested messages. Reuse configured accounts without a browser. Includes signatures, To/Cc, attachments, verified previews and duplicate-safe recovery. Credentials stay on the configured host.
